about: Ownership manifest read by scripts/lane-guard.mjs. Its never-promote (neverPromote), protected and brand rules block; the map rule only advises. Each entry maps a path glob to the map page that describes it, the lanes the path reaches, and whether it is protected. Lanes: enterprise (the hosted app, main), tester (agentforge-chat, tester/chat-first). personal (Nultron Personal, retired 2026-10-14, owes nothing) stays only on the apps/desktop entries, because it is the one lane those paths reach and every entry must name a lane. A file may match several entries: its map pages are the union, it is protected if any match is. 'map: null' means no map check. Since the 2026-10-15 repo split this repo is Nultron only: Nultron may be named in shared code, Toko Token may not, and no downstream repo syncs from main. Plan (history): docs/internal/white-label-and-agent-guardrails-plan.md. Map: docs/internal/maps/release-and-sync-lanes.md.
